title: Runtime Context SSR Render
description: SSR HTML кеш по binding_key + context_key (+ theme_signature) для SEO-first рендера страниц InstantCMS (content/view, content/category и т.д.).
notes: Context key is derived from current route + content identifiers
Cache entries should be guest-only by default
One HTML for all devices (device_type not part of key in MVP)
